name: Generic Amp
description: Three-band tone stack driving a saturating power section. Set the gain for preamp drive and use master to balance against the rest of the chain.

name: Generic Overdrive
description: Soft-clipping pedal-style drive with a one-pole tone control. Push drive for grit, roll tone back to tame the top end.

name: Generic Delay
description: Single-tap delay line with feedback and a dry/wet mix. Times up to two seconds; feedback stays below unity so repeats always decay.

name: Generic Reverb
description: Schroeder-style room built from four damped comb filters and two allpass stages. Size sets the decay length, damping rolls off the tail's high end.

name: Generic Chorus
description: LFO-swept delay line mixed against the dry signal. Rate sets the sweep speed, depth how far the pitch wanders.
